Quick summary:
- Our standard Redwood Private configurations (cold/warm/hot) show measured RTOs of 4–18 hours and RPOs of 0–60 minutes depending on data sync cadence and the chosen warm/hot topology.
- With Dedicated reserved pools + a pre-warmed standby region and DNS/TLS pre-provisioning, we can operationally achieve an observed RTO in the ~45–75 minute range in our internal tests.
- To contractually commit to <= 1 hour RTO for the payments-critical routes in APAC we require: Dedicated reserved capacity, an agreed pre-warm period (24–72 hours prior to go-live), shorter DNS TTLs managed by the customer, and a runbook attestation that we perform full warm failover drills quarterly. There is an estimated incremental monthly uplift for the reserved footprint and standby region; I’ve noted this requirement in HubSpot (HP-4389).
